methodology.execution: Isolated integration toolshed/shell servers; no Loom. Explicitly dispose prior browser runtime before navigation to prevent CPU profiler selecting stale idle workers. Fresh piece for every observation.

runtimePosture.evidence: Harness logs record serverExecution=false; author runtime explicitly declares enforce-explicit/persist; shell uses existing enforce-explicit/persist defaults.

methodology.boundary: Visible duration starts at native button click event (browser performance.now), ends when MutationObserver-driven predicate sees exactly N expected bubble elements with nonzero layout boxes and visible display/visibility. Pre-settle and target marking outside timer. No post-click runtime idle or view settle drives the measurement. StepTimer independently records click dispatch plus DOM-wait wall time.
methodology.profile: attachWorkerProfiler/startWorkerProfile/writeWorkerProfile; V8 worker samples with prepareCfc anywhere in parent chain form CFC bucket. Each repetition has nonzero prepareCfc samples. Inclusive function breakdowns overlap and must not be summed.
methodology.counters: before/after worker getLoggerCounts snapshots; counts are differences. Logger baselines reset before interaction. scheduler/run/action and scheduler/run/commit totals are worker milliseconds. Statistics sampled immediately after profile stop, so an asynchronous tail may extend beyond the first visible frame.
methodology.load: uptime load averages recorded independently for every raw row.
methodology.slope: Ordinary least squares log(median event-to-visible milliseconds) against log(N), four size medians.
methodology.labelFence: awaitViewSettled after event-to-visible, profile, counters and load snapshots, before all property/label reads.
methodology.diagnosticGap: Between baseline-r1 and final-r1, interrupted CFC-only final-r1 and N11 candidate correctness diagnostic ran. Final-r1 was completely rerun with candidate before recorded pair comparison.
methodology.readme: Exact normalized full snapshot comparison executable: /tmp/cfc-round2-browser-compare-v3.py. Raw row files and profiles remain in each arm directory.

limitations: SQLite fixture seeds one thread row whose labeled packed column already contains N-message JSON array; direct aggregate query was separately tried and failed identically on baseline and final (3 pattern assertions passed,5 undefined after selection). The timed selector/parser/natural-map boundary is representative post-SQL, but SQL aggregation is not exercised in v3.

Root VNode label queries return absent views for session output; author runtime reports absent/readFailed=false. Positive worker stored text-slot views and resolved carried text/class views are now captured and compared exactly. Text resolves to an inline data URI with carried labels, so asking its bare target for stored metadata returns absent by design.
Worker profiles include dispatch overhead outside exact event-to-visible interval and may include asynchronous tail; inclusive function buckets overlap.
Visible means nonzero layout boxes and visible CSS, not all messages simultaneously within viewport.
CFC share is whole profiled open, not a separately delimited single instantiation commit.
Per-observation uptime recorded; drift remains despite arm/repetition alternation. Only final v3 directories represent final paired evidence. Earlier v2 and diagnostic runs retained separately.

Attempted SQL INSERT...SELECT materialization of json_group_array into labeled threads was explicitly rejected identically by baseline/final labeled-database write guard; raw logs /tmp/cfc-round2-materialized-baseline-test.log and /tmp/cfc-round2-materialized-final-test.log. No guard bypass was attempted.

cardinality.meaning: Baseline map argument inference treats undeclared array/index/params as used, forwarding the complete labeled list into every child. Projection-aware inference omits these unused arguments. This eliminates the quadratic carried-entry visits in this fixture; final covercalls1 and wildcardqueries0 per open.
cardinality.scopeOfInference: Observed formula is not a proof of all N or an unavoidable lower bound; optimized actual workload disproves the claimed necessity of quadratic visits.

mapArgumentUsageFollowup.fix: Use existing schemaPathSelection; retain declared/open/legacy arguments. Fix helper base+branch combination with combineSchema, retaining explicit outer properties and structural schemas.
baselineInvestigationFindings: The emitted operation body reads only element.me and element.text. Its object argument schema declares only element and does not set additionalProperties:false.

inferListOpArgumentUsage calls ContextualFlowControl.getSchemaAtPath for index/array/params. Executing it against the exact emitted schema returns true for all four flags; each missing schema path resolves to {}.

ContextualFlowControl.schemaAtPath defaults defaultMissingProperty=true; with nonempty properties and a missing property it selects that default. getSchemaAtPath converts true to {}, which is not undefined.

map.ts:createRunInput includes array:listCell whenever usesArray is true, and passes that input for every created child. Thus the browser lowering has the same whole-array argument-carriage mechanism as the conservative builder case.

No new browser run or per-link transaction census was taken in this follow-up. The emitted-schema inference plus map source establish inclusion of the unused array; they do not allocate every term of the observed 18*N*N+4*N+1 cover-call formula to a particular link kind.

Pattern construction (builder/pattern.ts:597) sanitizes with sanitizeSchemaForLinks(argumentSchema, KeepAsCell.All); the diagnostic executed that exact sanitizer too. It leaves this emitted schema unchanged and sanitized argument-usage inference remains all true.
